name: wireguard_lwip
description: wireguard-lwip for ESP32. PlatformIO wrapper: sources live in components/microlink/components/wireguard_lwip (unmodified). Only the portable C crypto backend (crypto/refc) is built; the Cortex-M0 assembly backend under crypto/cortex is excluded. crypto/refc/x25519.c is also excluded because microlink bundles a byte-identical copy and PlatformIO links object files directly (not via archives), so both copies would collide; microlink's copy provides the x25519/X25519_BASE_POINT symbols.
